entities.summary: Václav Kaplický was a Czech writer, journalist and epic poet. He is best known as an author of historical fiction. Kaplický studied at Gymnasium in Tábor, finishing in 1914. In 1915 he was sent to the front in Galicia, where he was captured and became a prisoner of war the following year. Later he joined the Czechoslovak Legion. For his political opinions he was imprisoned by the legion and labeled a traitor. After returning to Czechoslovakia in 1921, he worked in civil service. Václav Kaplický was a authors & novelists from Červený Dvůr (Sezimovo Ústí) (1895-08-28, Červený Dvůr (Sezimovo Ústí)–1982-10-04). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
